title: styrax officinalis var. californicus
intro: Styrax officinalis var. californicus, commonly known as California benzoin or California styrax, is a plant species within the Styrax genus. It is a deciduous shrub native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico, valued for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of California benzoin include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe wounds, reduce pain, and prevent infection. The therapeutic actions of this plant include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, attributed to its bioactive constituents, including benzoin resin, styracol, and styraxin.
